headline: Cognizant reports a 75M transformer reached about 76% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 public evaluation tasks
summary: A September 21, 2026 Cognizant AI Lab post and linked public repository describe a 75-million-parameter autoregressive transformer trained from scratch for ARC-AGI. Cognizant reports about 76% pass@2 on the public ARC-AGI-1 evaluation set after a little over four hours of training and evaluation on one NVIDIA H100; an eight-model ensemble reportedly reaches about 80%. The post also reports about 17% on ARC-AGI-2 for one model and about 22% for the ensemble, while a faster approximately 17-minute configuration reaches about 44% on ARC-AGI-1. The repository says headline scores average multiple seeds, but its example pages show best-seed results among eight. These are first-party reported results on public evaluation tasks, not a private leaderboard result or an independent reproduction. The linked code and evaluation recipe were inspected at the README level but not executed or audited.
